ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say when a companion claimed he was given knowledge of the unseen?
ai.summary: In this episode from Nahj al-Balagha, a companion from the Banu Kalb tribe attributes the knowledge of the unseen (ghayb) to Imam Ali, prompting a humble yet significant response. This interaction highlights the Shia scholarly distinction between the absolute, divine knowledge of the Prophet and the derived, limited knowledge granted to the Imams, often contextualized within the broader theological debate on prophetic and imamic attributes.
